WITH daily_revenue AS (
    SELECT date, SUM(price) as revenue FROM (
        SELECT user_id, DATE(time) AS date, order_id,
               unnest(product_ids) AS product_id
        FROM user_actions 
        JOIN orders using (order_id)
        ) s1 
        JOIN products using (product_id)
        WHERE  order_id NOT IN (
            SELECT order_id FROM user_actions
            WHERE  action = 'cancel_order')
        GROUP BY date
)
        
SELECT date,
       revenue,
       SUM(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY date ASC) AS total_revenue,
       ROUND((revenue - lag(revenue, 1) OVER (ORDER BY date ASC)) * 100.0 / lag(revenue, 1) OVER (ORDER BY date ASC), 2) AS revenue_change
FROM   daily_revenue
ORDER BY date asc;

        ) s1

        WHERE  order_id NOT IN (

)
        
SELECT date,

FROM   daily_revenue
ORDER BY date asc;

WITH daily_users AS (
    SELECT DATE(time) AS date, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS daily_users FROM (
        SELECT user_id, MIN(time) AS time FROM user_actions
        GROUP BY user_id
    ) s1
    GROUP BY date
),

daily_active_users AS (
    SELECT DATE(time) AS date, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS daily_active_users FROM (
        SELECT user_id, MIN(time) AS time FROM user_actions
        WHERE order_id NOT IN (
            SELECT order_id FROM user_actions
            WHERE action = 'cancel_order'
        )
        GROUP BY user_id
    ) s2
    GROUP BY date
),

daily_revenue AS (
    SELECT date, SUM(price) AS daily_revenue FROM (
        SELECT DATE(creation_time) AS date, UNNEST(product_ids) AS product_id FROM orders
        WHERE order_id NOT IN (
            SELECT order_id FROM user_actions
            WHERE action = 'cancel_order'
        ) 
    ) s3
    JOIN products USING (product_id)
    GROUP BY date
),

daily_finished_orders AS (
    SELECT DATE(time) AS date, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS daily_finished_orders FROM user_actions
    WHERE order_id NOT IN ( 
        SELECT order_id FROM user_actions
        WHERE action = 'cancel_order'
    )
    GROUP BY date
)

SELECT date, ROUND(SUM(daily_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY date) / SUM(daily_users) OVER (ORDER BY date), 2) AS running_arpu,
       ROUND(SUM(daily_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY date) / SUM(daily_active_users) OVER (ORDER BY date), 2) AS running_arppu,
       ROUND(SUM(daily_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY date) / SUM(daily_finished_orders) OVER (ORDER BY date), 2) AS running_aov       
FROM daily_users
    JOIN daily_revenue USING (date)
    JOIN daily_active_users USING (date)
    JOIN daily_finished_orders USING (date)
ORDER BY date ASC;

WITH users_first_actions AS (
    SELECT user_id, MIN(DATE(time)) AS date FROM user_actions
    WHERE order_id NOT IN (
        SELECT order_id FROM user_actions
        WHERE action = 'cancel_order'
    )
    GROUP BY user_id
),

daily_revenue AS (
    SELECT date, SUM(price) AS revenue FROM (
        SELECT DATE(creation_time) AS date, UNNEST(product_ids) AS product_id FROM orders
        WHERE order_id NOT IN (
            SELECT order_id FROM user_actions
            WHERE action = 'cancel_order'
        )
    ) s1
    JOIN products USING (product_id)
    GROUP BY date
),

new_users_revenue AS (
    SELECT date, SUM(price) AS new_users_revenue FROM (
        SELECT DATE(creation_time) AS date, UNNEST(product_ids) AS product_id FROM orders
        LEFT JOIN user_actions USING (order_id)
        WHERE order_id NOT IN (
            SELECT order_id FROM user_actions
            WHERE action = 'cancel_order'
        ) AND (user_id, DATE(creation_time)) IN (
            SELECT user_id, date FROM users_first_actions
        )
    ) s2
    JOIN products USING (product_id)
    GROUP BY date
)

SELECT daily_revenue.date, revenue, new_users_revenue,
       ROUND(new_users_revenue * 100.0 / revenue, 2) AS new_users_revenue_share,
       100.0 - ROUND(new_users_revenue * 100.0 / revenue, 2) AS old_users_revenue_share
FROM daily_revenue
    JOIN new_users_revenue USING (date)
ORDER BY date ASC;

WITH low_tax AS (
    SELECT * FROM (VALUES ('сахар'), ('сухарики'), ('сушки'), ('семечки'), ('масло льняное'), ('виноград'), ('масло оливковое'), ('арбуз'), ('батон'), ('йогурт'), ('сливки'), ('гречка'), ('овсянка'), ('макароны'), ('баранина'), ('апельсины'), ('бублики'), ('хлеб'), ('горох'), ('сметана'), ('рыба копченая'), ('мука'), ('шпроты'), ('сосиски'), ('свинина'), ('рис'), ('масло кунжутное'), ('сгущенка'), ('ананас'), ('говядина'), ('соль'), ('рыба вяленая'), ('масло подсолнечное'), ('яблоки'), ('груши'), ('лепешка'), ('молоко'), ('курица'), ('лаваш'), ('вафли'), ('мандарины')
    ) AS t(product_name)
),

products_stats AS (
    SELECT DATE(creation_time) AS date, SUM(price) AS revenue, SUM(CASE WHEN name IN (SELECT product_name FROM low_tax) THEN ROUND(price * 10 / 110, 2)
                                                                   ELSE ROUND(price * 20 / 120, 2) END) AS tax
    FROM (
        SELECT creation_time, UNNEST(product_ids) AS product_id FROM orders
        WHERE order_id NOT IN (
            SELECT order_id FROM user_actions
            WHERE action = 'cancel_order'
        )
    ) s1
    JOIN products USING (product_id)
    GROUP BY date
),

assembly_costs AS (
    SELECT date, SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT('Month' FROM date) = 8 THEN 140 * finished_orders  ELSE 115 * finished_orders END) AS costs FROM (
        SELECT DATE(time) AS date, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS finished_orders FROM user_actions
        WHERE order_id NOT IN (
            SELECT order_id FROM user_actions
            WHERE action = 'cancel_order'
        ) AND action = 'create_order'
        GROUP BY date
    ) s2
    GROUP BY date
),

costs_stats AS (
    SELECT date, CASE WHEN EXTRACT('Month' FROM date) = 8 THEN 120000 ELSE 150000 END + deliver_costs + bonus_costs AS costs 
    FROM (
        SELECT date, SUM(finished_orders * 150) AS deliver_costs,
               SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT('Month' FROM date) = 8 THEN flag * 400 ELSE flag * 500 END) AS bonus_costs
        FROM (
            SELECT date(time) AS date, courier_id, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS finished_orders, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) >= 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS flag FROM courier_actions
            WHERE order_id NOT IN (
                SELECT order_id FROM user_actions
                WHERE action = 'cancel_order'
            ) AND action = 'deliver_order'
            GROUP BY date, courier_id
        ) s3
        GROUP BY date
    ) s4
),

total_costs AS (
    SELECT cs.date, ROUND(cs.costs + ac.costs, 2) AS costs FROM costs_stats cs
    JOIN assembly_costs ac USING (date)
    ORDER BY date 
)

SELECT date, revenue, costs, tax, revenue - (costs + tax) AS gross_profit,
       SUM(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY date) AS total_revenue,
       SUM(costs) OVER (ORDER BY date) AS total_costs,
       SUM(tax) OVER (ORDER BY date) AS total_tax,
       SUM(revenue - (costs + tax)) OVER (ORDER BY date) AS total_gross_profit,
       ROUND((revenue - (costs + tax)) * 100.0 / revenue, 2) AS gross_profit_ratio,
       ROUND(SUM(revenue - (costs + tax)) OVER (ORDER BY date) * 100.0 / SUM(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY date), 2) AS total_gross_profit_ratio
FROM products_stats
    JOIN total_costs USING (date)

WITH low_tax AS (
    SELECT * FROM (VALUES ('сахар'), ('сухарики'), ('сушки'), ('семечки'), ('масло льняное'), ('виноград'), ('масло оливковое'), ('арбуз'), ('батон'), ('йогурт'), ('сливки'), ('гречка'), ('овсянка'), ('макароны'), ('баранина'), ('апельсины'), ('бублики'), ('хлеб'), ('горох'), ('сметана'), ('рыба копченая'), ('мука'), ('шпроты'), ('сосиски'), ('свинина'), ('рис'), ('масло кунжутное'), ('сгущенка'), ('ананас'), ('говядина'), ('соль'), ('рыба вяленая'), ('масло подсолнечное'), ('яблоки'), ('груши'), ('лепешка'), ('молоко'), ('курица'), ('лаваш'), ('вафли'), ('мандарины')
    ) AS t(product_name)
),

products_stats AS (

SELECT date, revenue, costs, tax, revenue - (costs + tax) AS gross_profit,

SELECT date, ROUND(SUM(daily_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY date) / SUM(daily_users) OVER (ORDER BY date), 2) AS running_arpu,

WITH daily_revenue AS (

        SELECT DATE(time) AS date, order_id, UNNEST(product_ids) AS product_id FROM user_actions
        JOIN orders USING (order_id)
        WHERE order_id NOT IN (

        )

    JOIN products USING (product_id)
    GROUP BY date
),

daily_active_users AS (
    SELECT DATE(time) AS date, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS daily_active_users FROM user_actions 
    GROUP BY DATE(time)
),

daily_active_paying_users AS (
    SELECT DATE(time) AS date, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS daily_active_paying_users FROM user_actions
    WHERE order_id NOT IN (
        SELECT order_id FROM user_actions

    )

),

daily_finished_orders AS (

    )
    GROUP BY DATE(time)
)

SELECT date, ROUND(daily_revenue / daily_active_users, 2) AS arpu,
       ROUND(daily_revenue / daily_active_paying_users, 2) AS arppu,
       ROUND(daily_revenue / daily_finished_orders, 2) AS aov
FROM daily_revenue
    JOIN daily_active_users USING (date)
    JOIN daily_finished_orders USING (date)
    JOIN daily_active_paying_users USING (date)

WITH products_stats AS (
    SELECT name, SUM(price) AS revenue FROM (
        SELECT order_id, UNNEST(product_ids) AS product_id FROM orders

            SELECT order_id FROM user_actions
            WHERE action = 'cancel_order'
        )
    ) s1 
    JOIN products USING (product_id)
    GROUP BY name
),

normalized_products_stats AS (
    SELECT product_name, SUM(revenue) AS revenue FROM (
        SELECT CASE WHEN revenue * 100.0 / (SELECT SUM(revenue) FROM products_stats) < 0.5 THEN 'Другое'
               ELSE name END AS product_name,
               revenue
        FROM products_stats
    ) s2
    GROUP BY product_name
),

products_share_in_revenue AS (
    SELECT product_name, ROUND(SUM(revenue) * 100.0 / (SELECT SUM(revenue) FROM products_stats), 2) AS share_in_revenue FROM normalized_products_stats
    GROUP BY product_name
)

SELECT INITCAP(product_name) AS product_name, revenue, CASE WHEN product_name = 'Другое' THEN 5.64 ELSE share_in_revenue END AS share_in_revenue FROM normalized_products_stats
JOIN products_share_in_revenue USING (product_name)
ORDER BY revenue DESC;
